immigration.text: Kalra authored AB 1440 declaring that ICE and CBP agents are not state-licensed peace officers, saying California should protect all residents regardless of immigration status.
immigration.quote: in California, law enforcement officers are sworn to protect all residents, regardless of their immigration status

health.text: Kalra authored California's single-payer health care legislation (CalCare) and lists leading the fight for a single-payer system among his top priorities.
health.quote: Leading the fight for a single-payer health care system to ensure comprehensive, high-quality health care for all Californians
